name: Creep!Speak 101: The Deputy, The Gigolo, The Artist, The Boy & His Dog
source:
Creep!Speak is a monthly anthology series inspired by Twilight Zone and Black Mirror. Each story is told through a short visual novel that can be completed in 30 minutes.
